svg.title: Optical tweezers
svg.desc: Conceptual layout based on Thorlabs optical tweezers: https://www.thorlabs.com/catalogpages/V21/1825.PDF . Library plate splitters represent dichroic optics. Camera tracking only, not a quadrant-detector force readout. Sample section and focus detail are schematic; not to scale.

g.text: Magnified schematic; beam waist is not to scale.

g.text: Laser trapping and optical observation of microscopic particles
